description: Karnataka CM D K Shivakumar's 100-day agenda spans AI education, professional-course access, a proposed AI university and government recruitment, alongside measures aimed at creating one lakh new jobs.
body_lead: Bengaluru: Karnataka is seeking to connect education with employment through a series of initiatives spanning school-level AI education , access to professional courses, a proposed AI university and a large government recruitment drive . Chief Minister D K Shivakumar, in his 100-day message, highlighted measures including a 7.5% reservation for rural government-school students in professional courses, AI education from Class 6 onwards, a government-sponsored AI university and the filling of 72,000 government vacancies.
